mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO kb_chunk (library_id, media_id, content, embedding, chunk_index, metadata) VALUES
(#{chunk.libraryId}, #{chunk.mediaId}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.embedding}::vector, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.metadata}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT id, library_id, media_id, content, chunk_index, metadata, created_at, ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('simple', content), plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryTerms})) AS bm25_score FROM kb_chunk WHERE library_id = #{libraryId} AND to_tsvector('simple', content) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryTerms}) ORDER BY bm25_score DESC LIMIT #{topK}
